name: Netdata
description: Monitors infrastructure in real time at per-second granularity and exposes live metrics, logs, and alerts to agents through an official MCP server.

skills.name: Metric Query
skills.description: Queries live per-second infrastructure metrics across servers, containers, and services from one endpoint.

skills.name: Anomaly Detection
skills.description: Surfaces statistically anomalous behaviour using built-in machine learning trained per metric.

skills.name: Log Search
skills.description: Searches systemd and application logs alongside metrics to correlate incidents with system events.

skills.name: Alert Inspection
skills.description: Lists active and past alerts with thresholds so agents can triage what is currently firing.
